text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I had the pleasure of watching that 
nail-biting race the other day!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
A MASSIVE victory in the battle between 
rivals! What a sensational performance! 
Keep up the fierce momentum going forward!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I received high praise for <chrname>'s victory over 
a formidable rival! It fired me up to work 
even harder...!
